assessment: The manuscript makes an important contribution to feedback control in neural systems. The analysis and modeling together make a compelling case for a nested system, combining visual with mechanosensory feedback, for head and body control in the fruit fly. The experiments that support these results are compelling and well-executed and the strategies for dissecting and modeling feedback are valuable to the field, and broadly applicable to other neural control systems. This paper will reach a wide audience; researchers investigating biological control systems, visual feedback, and gaze stabilization will all be interested in these results.
